negative_control.reason: Freezing the three signature squash peaks to 1.0 removes the jelly wobble's identity: at frames 30/40/50 the bubble edge is ~20-45px from the truth, which must blow the doors ROI past max_mae.

checks.reason: doors ROI covers the whole travel+wobble region (x40-370, y340-510); chrome and anchor-bubble pin the nav/divider/avatar and the unmoved 'see you there' bubble. Re-encoding the identical source frame through the same libx264 pipeline already costs MAE~2.0; the observed worst ROI frame is ~3.3 from small-font AA residue on top of that floor, so 5 leaves ~1.5x headroom while any real motion mistake shifts bubble edges tens of px and fails.

description: A new incoming grey iMessage bubble ('doors at 7') pops in ~70px below its resting slot at frame 15, slides up under easing for ~11 frames while vertically stretched ~10%, then performs a volume-preserving damped spring wobble about its bottom-center pivot: scaleX peaks ~1.18 (frame 30), swings to ~0.90 (frame 40), ~1.08 (frame 50), ~0.965 (frame 60), ~1.02 (frame 70), ~0.997 (frame 80) and settles to 1.0 by frames 87-99. scaleY tracks the inverse. Bubble and label scale together as one group; header chrome, both earlier messages and the divider never move.

From frame 27 the group (bubble + label, pivot bottom-center ~x185.5,y421) runs a damped spring: scaleX 1.18@f30, 0.90@f40, 1.08@f50, 0.965@f60, 1.02@f70, 0.997@f80, settled ~1.0 by f87-99; scaleY is the inverse.
